summary.text: Vance Smith Jr. represents Georgia House District 138; he was first elected to the House in 1992, served 17 years including five as chairman of the Transportation Committee, and returned to the legislature in 2018.

paragraphs.text: He was a Harris County commissioner from 1987 to 1990 and was appointed commissioner of the Georgia Department of Transportation in 2009, serving until 2011.
He is a lifelong Harris County resident and earned a bachelor's degree from Columbus College, now Columbus State University.
